meta.name: Obi Wan Kenobi
meta.description: During the reign of the Galactic Empire, former Jedi Master, Obi-Wan Kenobi, embarks on a crucial mission to confront allies turned enemies and face the wrath of the Empire.

videos.title: Part I
videos.overview: Obi-Wan Kenobi lives a humble existence on Tatooine. Despite the dangers of being a Jedi survivor at the height of the Empire, Kenobi is forced to emerge from hiding.

videos.title: Part II
videos.overview: Obi-Wan’s mission brings him to a crime-ridden world, home to all manner of scum and villainy.

videos.title: Part III
videos.overview: Obi-Wan searches for allies as he attracts the attention of the Empire, threatening the locals.

videos.title: Part IV
videos.overview: Obi-Wan Kenobi plots a daring mission into enemy territory.

videos.title: Part V
videos.overview: Obi-Wan plans his next move as the Empire, closing in, tries to draw him out.

videos.title: Part VI
videos.overview: Obi-Wan is drawn into a confrontation with Vader, as Luke's fate hangs in the balance.

meta.slogan: Between darkness and defeat, hope survives.
